About Nile Orphan Care

Our Story

Founded in 2008, Nile Orphan Care began as a small initiative to help orphaned children in the Nile region. What started with caring for just 10 children has grown into a comprehensive organization supporting hundreds of children across multiple locations.

Our Vision

To create a world where every orphaned child has access to love, education, healthcare, and opportunities to build a successful future.

Our Values

  • Compassion and unconditional love
  • Quality education for all
  • Dignity and respect for every child
  • Transparency and accountability
  • Community partnership and support
); }; export default About;
